name: Aniki no Niizuma ~Otto no Koto ga Suki na no ni....~
original_name: 兄貴の新妻～夫のことが好きなのに…～
source:
Natsumi lives a happy life with her husband. However, she is worried about his younger brother, Kurou, who lives together with them, because of his delinquency. But one day, when she is involved in a trouble, Kurou saves her and she says, "I'll do anything for you." Like this, she sleeps with Kurou... At first, she doesn't want it, but she gradually gets addicted to his techniques... Days later, Haruka, her younger sister suddenly visits their house and sees them having sex...

[From erogeShop]
translation:
夏美与丈夫过着幸福生活，却担心共同居住的丈夫之弟九郎，因为他一直行为不良。一天，夏美遇到麻烦时，九郎救了她，她便说：“我什么都愿意为你做。”就这样，她与九郎发生了关系…起初她并不情愿，却逐渐沉迷于他的技巧…几天后，妹妹遥突然到访，撞见两人做爱…

[From erogeShop]
